description: Rangers who bond with beasts and command them in battle.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description: Summon beast companion. Gains actions on your turn. HP equal to your HP.

features.name: Coordinated Attack
features.description: Beast attacks as bonus action, deals extra damage.

features.name: Mighty Companion
features.description: Beast attacks twice. Gains AC bonus.

features.name: Beast Guardian
features.description: Beast can protect allies, taking damage meant for them.
